name: PHIL 5312
title: Seminar in the Philosophy of Science
description: A discussion of selected current, methodological issues in the philosophy of science. Topics may include scientific realism versus nonrealism; theories of scientific explanation; the nature of scientific revolutions; theories of the lawfulness of nature; and feminist theories of science. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Philosophy, others with consent.
